description: Reaction kinetics, half-life & Arrhenius — Integrated rate laws for zero, first and second order reactions and radioactive decay: give k, half_life (with units like 5730y, 8.02d, 10min) or isotope (built-in table of 20 common isotopes such as C-14, I-131, Cs-137, Tc-99m, F-18) plus c0 (default 100), then t= for the concentration and percent remaining at a time, or c= for the time to reach a concentration. mode=arrhenius with k1, temp1, temp2 (K or 25C) and ea (kJ/mol) gives k2, or with k2 gives the activation energy and pre-exponential factor. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
